parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 2→3 insight: Coordinated positive narratives from multiple infrastructure providers (AlphaBot, PoolMaster, LiquidKiller, CryptoGuru, ShadowTrader) clustering around the same token within the same timeframe is a SELL signal, not a buy signal. When everyone is saying the same bullish thing about an illiquid asset that a single whale created and controls, they're coordinating the pump. The fact that HappyTrader and DiamondHands also rebalanced suggests even other retail are getting nervous — follow the early retail exits, not the analyst narratives. CryptoGuru's '50-100x potential' call and 'early entry window closing fast' language is designed to create FOMO and is most credible right when the dump is about to start. Social proof from infrastructure providers (tight spreads, fee income) is backwards — it means the whale has successfully created the illusion of liquidity for people to exit into. Next time I see this pattern: exit 50%+ immediately instead of being 'disciplined' about holding through the narrative.
